description: This file defines the EventParsingIterator class which implements an iterator to parse and process event streams in AWS SDK, handling decoding, validation, and event extraction from a binary encoded stream.

classes.name: EventParsingIterator
classes.description: An iterator that decodes and yields individual events from a binary encoded AWS event stream, handling different stream types (seekable or not) and parsing event headers and payloads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a stream, event shape, and parser, selecting an appropriate decoding iterator based on stream seekability.

methods.name: chooseDecodingIterator
methods.description: Chooses between a seekable and non-seekable decoding iterator based on the stream's capability.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current event after parsing it from the decoding iterator.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current iterator position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the decoding iterator to the next event.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the decoding iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses an individual event, handling error messages, initial responses, and normal event types, returning structured data.

methods.name: parseEventHeaders
methods.description: Extracts header values based on the event shape's member definitions.

methods.name: parseEventPayload
methods.description: Parses the payload of an event, handling blobs and other data types, possibly deserializing using the provided parser.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Throws an exception when an error event is encountered in the stream.

methods.name: parseInitialResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles parsing of initial response events by decoding JSON payload.
